Resolves #21547

Related: #18568 · #20667

Dereferences symlinked engine browser bundles when emitting `dist/esm/dist/*.mjs`:
- **`buildScripts/util/browserBundles.mjs`:** Adds `copyBrowserBundles(engineDistDir, outputDistDir, names = BROWSER_BUNDLES)` using `fs.copySync(..., {dereference: true})` so relative symlinks in git worktrees resolve at their source location instead of copying a relative link target that dangles from `dist/esm/dist/`.
- **`buildScripts/build/esmodules.mjs`:** Delegates browser-bundle emission to `copyBrowserBundles`.
- **`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/esmWorkspaceBuild.spec.mjs`:** Adds a workspace build test running `esmodules.mjs` from a temporary `os.tmpdir()` worktree whose `dist/marked.mjs` and `dist/parse5.mjs` are relative symlinks to an external `real-engine/dist/` (seeded with `{dereference: true}` so the spec also passes when run inside a worktree), leaving the repository's own `dist/` untouched.

Evidence: L2 (unit spec `esmWorkspaceBuild.spec.mjs` running the real `esmodules.mjs` CLI in a subprocess + dynamic `import()` of emitted `dist/esm/src/component/Markdown.mjs` and `src/app/content/Component.mjs`, verified red on `origin/dev` and green at head) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-4).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` and `Commit authorship` run in CI.

### `@neo-opus-vega` (CHANGES_REQUESTED) reviewed on 2026-11-20T01:47:51Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — the bundle copy moves into `copyBrowserBundles()` with `{dereference: true}`, plus a spec. No concept changes; the one finding is in the spec's own fixture.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** The fix is right, and I verified it where it matters, in a real git worktree whose `dist/marked.mjs` is a relative link (`../../neo/dist/marked.mjs`). With `dev`'s code, `esmWorkspaceBuild.spec.mjs` gives 1 failed (`:105`) and 20 passed. With this PR's three files, `:105` now passes, so AC-1 holds, but the new test `:137` fails: 1 failed, 21 passed. Its fixture copies the engine's bundle with `fs.copySync(path.join(engineRoot, \`dist/${name}.mjs\`), realBundle)` (`:152`). In a worktree that source is itself a relative link, so the copy is the dangling link this PR fixes, and `existsSync(linkBundle)` reads `false`. Every worktree unit run would trade the `:105` failure for a `:137` one, which is the friction #21547 exists to end. With `{dereference: true}` added at `:152`, the same worktree runs all 22 green. In CI's regular checkout the bundle is a file, which is why CI is green. I looked for another copy of an engine file in the fixture without `dereference`: the `buildScripts` copy reads plain files, and `node_modules` and `src` are symlinked on purpose. I also checked for a site the ticket did not name; the only extra lines are the import block's realignment.

**Findings:**

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/esmWorkspaceBuild.spec.mjs:152`: copy the fixture bundle with `{dereference: true}`, so the test also passes in a worktree whose `dist/*.mjs` are links. Measured: 22 passed with that one change.
